question: Can a 9-slot sticky assignment-cache policy better preserve original baseline identity after a transient geometry shock than the recency-overwriting policy, without increasing the number of memory slots?
hypothesis: Avoiding overwrites of previously observed still-legal cached assignments may reduce evaluator-only baseline restoration drift but also increase churn and suppress new assignments due to stale occupancy; assess both.
population: Same 12-observation fixed Y033 program: logical0..3 baseline, logical4..5 shock+5 cells, logical0..5 recovery, SHA256-keyed heterogenous 16 motif/cell universe, 7 active and <=9 cached slots, radius2 full matching. New development seeds72..75 and heldout76..79.
arms: sham recent-cache writes but never reads
recent observed-state cache that pops active entries and overwrites departing entries with the last observed assignment (Y033)

sticky 9-slot assignment-cache, never overwrite a stored assignment on departure if already present; retain cached active entry if its placement remains legal, otherwise discard; when an active motif is not in cache, store its observed assignment only on subsequent departure, subject to 9-slot LRU eviction. No extra per-key counters, age fields, or memory cells.
metrics: Recovery-stage returning-key churn and evaluator-only baseline identity drift, per heldout seed and phase, search calls, exact cache writes and occupancy (NOT assumed equal because this policy deliberately changes writes), legal preference hits; all arms must stay <=9 cached identities and 7 active with 16 cells.
classification: STICKY_RESTORES_BASELINE if sticky aggregate baseline drift strictly lower than recent and no heldout seed increases drift, while sticky recovery churn does not increase in aggregate. STICKY_TRADEOFF if drift decreases but churn increases. STICKY_HARM if baseline drift increases. Otherwise NO_BENEFIT. INVALID for Hall-oracle disagreement or duplicate geometry signatures; GEOMETRY_DEFICIENCY if fewer than seven matches.
validity: All geometry signature SHA256 unique within new cohort, independent exhaustive Hall matching, policy never queries baseline evaluator or future shock, immutable prereg/science code, no extra slots or first-use retries; one full regression. Archive all outcomes and write differences.
claim_limit: Finite synthetic placement identity, no general intelligence or accepted-ref mutation.
